# St. Thomas HVAC Pros

> St. Thomas HVAC Pros is a local HVAC company serving St. Thomas, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.
